definitions.explanation: A licensed animal doctor. This is the formal word used in laws, licences, and professional contexts; in conversation people usually shorten it to {獣医|じゅうい}.

examples.japanese: {姉|あね}は{獣医師|じゅういし}になった。
examples.english: My older sister became a veterinarian.

examples.japanese: {獣医師|じゅういし}の{免許|めんきょ}を{取|と}るには{六年|ろくねん}かかる。
examples.english: It takes six years to get a veterinary licence.

examples.japanese: {牧場|ぼくじょう}の{獣医師|じゅういし}は、{牛|うし}や{馬|うま}の{健康|けんこう}{管理|かんり}も{担当|たんとう}している。
examples.english: The ranch's veterinarian is also responsible for the health management of the cattle and horses.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {獣医師|じゅういし}{免許|めんきょ}: veterinary licence
- {獣医師|じゅういし}{国家|こっか}{試験|しけん}: the national veterinary examination
- {獣医師|じゅういし}に{相談|そうだん}する: to consult a vet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {獣医|じゅうい}: vet — the everyday short form; what you say when taking a pet in
- {医師|いし}: doctor (of people) — the same 〜{師|し} "licensed practitioner" suffix
- {動物|どうぶつ}{病院|びょういん}: animal hospital, veterinary clinic — the place rather than the person
